Title: Login with valid credentials
TestSteps: Enter valid username and password;Click Login

Title: Login with invalid username
TestSteps: Enter invalid username and valid password;Click Login

Title: Login with invalid password
TestSteps: Enter valid username and invalid password;Click Login

Title: Login with empty fields
TestSteps: Leave username and password empty;Click Login

Title: Add new employee with valid data
TestSteps: Navigate to Add Employee;Enter valid details;Click Save

Title: Add employee with missing mandatory fields
TestSteps: Navigate to Add Employee;Leave mandatory fields empty;Click Save

Title: Search employee by name
TestSteps: Navigate to Employee List;Enter employee name;Click Search

Title: Assign leave to employee
TestSteps: Navigate to Assign Leave;Select employee;Enter leave details;Submit
